blocks.provider: FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-01 — KEEP acquisition-only provider selection. A valid paid Conjure Flora acquisition permanently binds its actual qualifying personal casting route and the ability operand supplied by that route. Later loss, expiry, retraining-away or temporary unavailability of that casting grant does not by itself remove Conjure Flora, reselect its provider, prohibit an otherwise legal Flora creation/command/Bloom Burst, terminate an existing seedling or disable an already armed entry trap. Current prepared repertoire, renewable casting charges and RP are not new ongoing Flora prerequisites. This does not qualify a NEW feat acquisition through a grant that is actually gone; ACQ-03 still governs that separate snapshot. Flora is a magical nonspell feat, not a cast through the provider: a spell-only prohibition applies only to its actual scope, Silence still blocks an audible command, and an effect actually suppressing this feat, a plant, its magic or the required action applies under that effect's own rule. NEW explicit lost-provider representation: retain the original provider/ability binding and compute Flora DC as 8 + the owner's current lawful PB + the current modifier of that bound ability; no alternative route, Wisdom default, reconstructed casting entitlement or favorable old ability score is substituted. A missing or invalid original acquisition/provider record is not cured by this rule. Completed results are not recalculated, and existing body HP/save snapshots, deadlines, spent uses and ownership are not reset.
blocks.secondCreationWindow: FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-02–03 — NEW second-creation window completion. Each legally completed first creation records one original use ID, its first-plant ID and that plant's original minute deadline, with at most one additional creation unspent. This is a bounded open-use record even when the owner is below total level 10; it is not another rest use or an immediately usable creation at that level. Admit a second creation only while that same first plant remains present and unended, before its original deadline, with the additional creation unspent, current total character level at least 10, actual free plant capacity, and every ordinary Action, ground, range, line-of-effect and use predicate satisfied. The level-10 condition is live at the additional Action, not snapshotted at first creation. Genuine advancement during that open window can make the existing unspent permission usable, but creates no body, charge, healing or new window. Destruction, uprooting, Bloom Burst consumption, expiry or another actual ending of the first plant permanently closes any unused additional-creation permission immediately; its old future deadline does not keep that permission alive. Suppression without an actual ending is not by itself an ending. A legal additional creation consumes that one permission and costs its own Action, but no second rest use; its own minute begins at its own creation. Once the second plant exists, ending the first does not shorten the second's independent deadline. No ended plant, spent permission, missed deadline, level change, recovery, new ID or subsequent body can reopen the old use. A later beneficial rest restores only the ordinary creation allowance under FS-06; a later first creation starts a genuinely new use.
blocks.committedCommand: FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW split command/phase completion. On the owner's regular turn, first establish a legal shared Bonus Action, an available owner/numbered-round offensive-companion allowance, and actual receipt of the required within-60-ft audible or visible command by each nominated participating plant. At that legal commitment spend the Bonus Action and that one shared offensive allowance once; record the owner, original regular-turn/round identity, participating plant IDs, one chosen mode and target or area, its permitted origin or nominated Lash origins, and the immediately following attached phase. This is a paid pending command, not a Readied action, independent plant turn or extra allowance. It need not be the owner's last voluntary decision that turn. Resolve it once in the attached phase after that same regular turn's actual end processing, using the preserved schedule; an extra turn neither advances nor duplicates that phase. Recheck the surviving unended, unsuppressed, otherwise capable participating plant and the mode's actual target/area, range, perception and line-of-effect requirements. For Lash, an independently legal surviving nominated origin may support the same selected target; losing the selected Spore/Entangle origin does not authorize another origin or mode. For an area, resolve its actual occupants at that phase. If the chosen outcome is no longer legal, close the pending command with no effect, no refund, no new target and no carry to a later phase. After actual receipt, later owner incapacity, Silence, loss of owner-to-plant sight/range/channel, or owner death alone does not retract that command: no continuous concentration/channel/consciousness requirement is added. These states can prevent a NEW command or personal creation/Bloom Burst. An effect expressly cancelling the pending command or disabling/ending its plant still controls. Once committed, no other companion or armed trap can spend the same owner-round allowance, and the phase does not spend it a second time.
blocks.ownerInstanceContinuity: FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW explicit owner/instance continuity. These particular one-minute, nonconcentration Flora bodies do not end merely because their owner is incapacitated or dies; retain the same owner, mode, actual body state, original deadline and no-resource restrictions. No recipient, ally, host, companion or replacement actor inherits control. A received pending command may resolve only at its already attached original phase under the split-command rule, even if the owner's live initiative slot is removed; preserve that one scheduled phase, not a new recurring independent turn. An already armed Trapcasting plant may perform its specified first-eligible-entry exception without a new owner Action/Reaction or remote command channel, even while its owner cannot act or is dead, but it still needs the actual qualifying entry, operative plant/trap, target legality and unspent same-owner numbered-round allowance. Incapacity/death neither refreshes that allowance nor rearms or moves the trap. Preserve the owner's last lawful PB/selected-ability state when its live actor view ends, applying any subsequently due source-defined changes; death is not a zero ability score, a new provider or a freeze of expiring modifiers. Use that continuing lawful record for later Flora DCs; a missing authoritative operand is an invalid/unestablished input, not permission to invent one. Lawful recovery continues the same history without replaying missed phases or refilling anything. Ending a generating plant still ends its own Poisoned/Restrained records immediately. A legally committed Bloom Burst binds its existing DC/type/area event, consumes its body before its one payload, and does not fail merely because that required consumption has occurred; it grants no other action to the ended body. Other independently applicable cancellation, suppression, condition, duration and target rules retain their own actual scope. No Animal Companion release/death rule or standard-companion movement/Dodge/attack is imported into these fixed Flora profiles.
blocks.trapcastingBinding: FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 interface binding. Apply Conjure Flora's FLQ-01 provider and FLQ-04 owner/instance continuity completions to these actual Flora bodies. A valid earlier acquisition remains necessary, but continuing possession or immediate usability of its original casting provider is not an additional trap prerequisite. The entry exception is automatic only as already specified; it needs no new command and does not require a living/conscious owner, but uses that same owner's conserved numbered-round offensive allowance. A legally committed ordinary Flora command already spends that allowance before its attached phase, so entry cannot steal or duplicate it. A new personal Bloom Burst still requires its legal Bonus Action, perception, range, line of effect and unspent shared allowance. Ending the first plant by a Burst closes any unused second-creation window; a second plant already created keeps its own original deadline. Verdant Bond-only ownership still creates no Flora body or casting provider, and no new unreviewed conjured-plant profile is admitted.
